title: Background launcher end misreads --detach when a launcher option consumes a bare -- as its value
outcome: At a Claude Bash background task's end, the host decides whether a test-launcher command was detached exactly as scripts/test-launcher.mjs parses its options: a value-taking option (--notify, --engram-binary and the like) consumes the next word even when that word is `--` or `--detach`, and only an unconsumed `--` ends the launcher's options.
acceptance: attach_claude_background_launcher_artifact classifies a launch as detached exactly when the launcher's own option parsing would enable --detach: launcher option values are consumed before the `--` separator is recognised, so `full --input commit --notify -- --notify coordinator --detach` is detached and records TerminalNotConfirmed, and `full --notify --detach` is not detached; shown by behaviour tests for both lines and for `focused --detach -- cargo test` (detached).
